Do NOT use for GPU inference CLUSTERS (multi-node / fleet-scale vLLM / Ray serving) — this is for single-endpoint LOCAL LLMs; point cluster/serving work to inference-aiops. Also not for hypervisors, storage, backup, Kubernetes, or network devices. Passive inventory/state auditing plus opt-in route-through content governance, with a bundled governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers). A transparent capture proxy is v0.2 roadmap.
